finding: Upstream emits the mandatory ByBlock, ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE rows before invoking the consumer callback, and offers setCanonicalLineTypeMetadata to preserve their source table-entry metadata. LibreCAD did not call that hook, so it could not preserve those application groups through the upstream-linked filter.

consumerChange.scope: Collect the three archived canonical LTYPE records and pass them before write. Compile-time detection makes the call a no-op for the older bundled codec, which has no hook.

validation: The upstream-linked LibreCAD filter imports all three generated application groups, writes them on their respective mandatory rows, and reimports them: 18 assertions pass.
A bundled-linked incremental probe compiles and passes 12 assertions for the preexisting fallback behavior. Its lack of metadata preservation remains a limitation of that older codec.
The upstream-linked MTEXT selector, DIMASSOC/MPOLYGON selector and legacy DIMSTYLE linetype roundtrip remain green.
The patch passes forward apply check on parent 44ef026 and reverse apply check on 9f82b2b. Clean-clone source inventory regeneration and check pass with 1,181 released files.
limits: The consumer commit is local and unmerged; the bundled fallback does not preserve this metadata. The incremental bundled probe is not a clean platform qualification. No support claim or phase gate is promoted.
